BH-1636. Space-separated <cli>@<box-id> pairs (box ids as cron_box_id_for prints them: hub, project-4, small...). A listed pair whose CLI reads MISSING on that box is not an alert; its TSV row and DB row say 'not required on this box (CLI_CHECK_OPTIONAL)'. Only MISSING is waived: an installed CLI below its floor, behind the hub or split across PATHs still alerts. A token not matching ^[a-z0-9_-]+@[a-z0-9_-]+$ is ignored and named in logs/cli-version-check.log. Empty = every CLI required on every box. Read by bin/cli-version-check.sh as ${CLI_CHECK_OPTIONAL:-}.

BH-2626. Seconds a box's self-reported cli_checked_at (bin/box-self-report.sh, hourly) stays fresh enough to judge the box from its box_status row instead of ssh-ing it. Default 7200 = 2x the box-self-report lane's hourly period. 0 = self-reports ignored; every box is ssh'd, as before BH-2626. Non-numeric falls back to 7200. Read by bin/cli-version-check.sh as ${CLI_CHECK_SELF_REPORT_FRESH_S:-7200}.

BH-2626. Maximum age in seconds of a box's last full ssh probe before a box judged from its self-report row is ssh'd anyway, so grok MISSING/floors, the per-box *_MODEL floors and the cron-vs-login PATH split, which the self-report row cannot answer, are still checked. Default 604800 = a week; stamped per box under state/. 0 = every box is ssh'd every run, as before BH-2626. Non-numeric falls back to 604800. Read by bin/cli-version-check.sh as ${CLI_CHECK_FULL_PROBE_S:-604800}.
